newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sprint 1998 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sprint 1998 estimate cut.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Michael Elling said he was cutting his estimate of Sprint Corp earnings per share for 1998 by $0.60 to $2.60, factoring in increased dilution of from a buildout of PCS territories following D, E and F band auctions. -- Stock remains a buy, Elling said. He sees total $1.40-$1.50 dilution per share for 1998. -- Stock 1/2 firmer at 40-3/4 at 1030 EST/1530 GMT (( Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712))
